name: Watermelon Burst - Infused Ice Packs (Rosin, Hash, and Diamonds) 1g
description: Rove 1G Ice Pack Preroll, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin then they're expertly rolled. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test up to 40% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls. Premium Organic Flower. Get ready for the perfect balance of relaxation and energy with our Watermelon Burst. Our strain offers a juicy mix of sweet melon, head-rushing euphoria and a unique smoking experience.
